ops.oldText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of one year thereafter, both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.
ops.newText: During an individual's involvement in the provision of services under this Agreement and for a period of 12 months thereafter, both parties mutually agree not to solicit or allow its respective affiliates to solicit any employee of the other party who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.

ops.text: The foregoing restriction does not apply to general advertisements or to unsolicited approaches by an individual.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We changed the operator from "hire" to "solicit", made the restriction expressly mutual, and ran it only during each covered individual's involvement in the services and for 12 months thereafter, with the two standard carve-outs; our playbook treats no-hire covenants and restrictions covering all personnel as unacceptable.
proposal.summary: Convert the mutual no-hire into an expressly mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the services, running only for 12 months after that involvement ends, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.

mappings.element: Non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.
Non-solicit limited to 12 months from the end of their involvement.
